supersedes_shell_script.name: 202608292126-pre-snapped-config-adapter.js
supersedes_shell_script.behaviour: carried forward verbatim; same layer closure, same failure mode, same public state object
supersedes_shell_script.hash_basis: LF-normalised content, as served; the repository hashes git blob bytes, not the CRLF working copy

measurement.parity: every distance checked equal to the canonical module in tools/proofs/202608311910-neon-substation-links.proof.mjs
measurement.scope_note: 11 kV is excluded: rare for utility-scale export and often a private network behind the meter

supersedes_cartridge.reason: the composer has one slot type and four shell scripts, three already used; the layout needs the same map handle the links cartridge already captures, so it extends it rather than claiming a fourth slot

ported_from.arithmetic: carried across unchanged; the proof re-derives the sandbox formula independently and compares on six input cases
deliberate_differences: one Earth radius: the sandbox measures on 6378.137 but builds geometry with turf.destination on 6371.0088, mixing two radii inside one drawing; the Atlas ships no turf and every operation here is canonical
grab rather than mode-switch: the array is dragged, rotation has a handle, route vertices are dragged, inserted and removed without a commit step
the electron flow runs along the collectors and the export cable in the direction power flows

central AC sizing is corrected, not carried: gis-sld-v5-calculations.js line 147 computes total_blocks * central_skid_mva * inv_per_mv, but total_blocks already contains inv_per_mv, so the inverters sharing a skid enter the answer squared, and a count of inverters is multiplied by a transformer rating. On the shipped defaults that reported 211.2 MW where the inverters total 105.6 MW and the skids 52.8 MVA; on a 3-inverter skid it reported 1425.6 against 158.4, a factor of nine. The Atlas reports the smaller of the two nameplates and names the element that limits export. The same fault is still in the sandbox this was ported from.

entry_points.pipelinenews_map_button: a deep link with latitude, longitude and technology draws the links, writes the distances onto the engine's own card, ticks the Subs control AND the project's own technology control, and drops a pin on the project itself so the scheme the card describes is visible under it
entry_points.layout: a button on the project card; the array starts on the project and the cable runs to the nearest substation found

capacity_basis.problem: REPD's figure is nominally MWelec but schemes report it as AC export and as DC MWp, and the register does not carry the distinction
capacity_basis.handling: nothing is fitted until the user declares the basis; the unstated case shows a red notice rather than a default
capacity_basis.why_it_matters: matching AC when the figure was DC oversizes the connection by the DC/AC ratio, which drives export limitation, curtailment and the size of the offer
capacity_basis.fit: only the block count moves - ring main circuits in string mode, rings in central; ratings, string length and module choice are untouched, and the residual is reported

project_pin.shape: a hollow ring around the site, toggled from the card
project_pin.why_not_a_dot: a filled dot in the technology colour was invisible in Chrome at zoom 12 on Botley West: it sat under the engine's own pixel for the same project, and the neon links converging on it are drawn in that same colour, so it disappeared into its own arrival point
project_pin.what_the_ring_answers: which of these is the project the card is about
project_pin.control_lookup: input[data-layer-id="<technology>"], the attribute the engine tags its own control with; the label text is a fallback only, because the labels carry live counts

central_sizing.reported_by: the Codex session auditing this estate in parallel, 202608312124
central_sizing.confirmed: dimensionally, and against the shipped defaults, in the proof
central_sizing.export: min(inverters x inverter AC, skids x skid MVA)
central_sizing.string_mode: untouched, and still reproduces the sandbox exactly on every case

boot.trigger: whichever of style.load or load arrives first, then an 8s timer
boot.why: map.once("load") fires only after a frame is painted, so a basemap that never serves tiles stopped the grid maths installing at all; observed live with style.json, tiles.json and the sprite all at 200 and not one vector tile fetched
boot.independence: the distances are arithmetic over substation coordinates and need no map; layers need a parsed style, not a frame
boot.refuses: to boot with no style at all, which would fail on the first addSource
boot.reported_ios: Vikram, 2026-08-31: the map from Pipeline News does not load on iPhone. iOS Safari delays or drops the first paint under memory pressure, which is exactly the condition this removes as a dependency. Not yet confirmed on a device.

status_surface.why: a black map is indistinguishable from a broken one, and the Atlas boots a 35.7 MB query engine before it can answer anything
status_surface.waiting: Loading the grid data - the distances need it.
status_surface.failed: The grid data has not finished loading, so no distances can be measured yet. This is usually the network rather than the project.
status_surface.retry: re-runs the arrival, not the page: a reload on a phone pays for the whole engine again and the deep link is in the URL either way
status_surface.sizing: min(92vw, 420px) - the viewport, not a desktop column
status_surface.mobile_first: Vikram, 2026-08-31: build for the phone first and let it scale up, because the link that reaches most readers arrives in a WhatsApp message

label_glyphs.symptom: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'width') once per rendered frame; 4,218 on a cold load here, 50+ in about 20 seconds on mounting the layout, seen independently by the Codex session
label_glyphs.cause: a symbol layer with no glyph atlas -- either the style carries no glyphs endpoint, or it has one and the assumed font is not served by it; the font was named literally rather than taken from the style that has to serve it
label_glyphs.fix: ask the style: no glyphs endpoint means no labels, which is a quiet map rather than a broken one; otherwise borrow a font the style already labels with, because that one is definitely served
label_glyphs.why_it_matters_on_a_phone: an exception per frame is a main thread that never idles: heat, battery, and a page that stops answering touches
label_glyphs.second_half: having a glyphs endpoint is not the same as reaching it: the style declared tiles.basemaps.cartocdn.com/fonts on the same CDN that had just returned 200 for style.json and then served no vector tiles at all, which gives the identical null atlas and 5,362 exceptions in thirty seconds
label_glyphs.pre_flight: one fetch of the 0-255 range, the same request the renderer would make; no answer means no labels, and the layer is never added

scope_closure.scope: GridAtlas v9.22 pre-flight the glyph range
